channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Fighting re-erupts in Yemen and civilians are paying the price
item.description: More than 900 people have been killed or injured and at least 5,000 families have fled their homes in less than a week.

item.title: Russia strikes cargo vessels, steel plants across Ukraine
item.description: Russia's Defence Ministry says its forces have struck several industrial facilities across Ukraine.

item.title: BRICS meets in India: What’s on the agenda, why it matters
item.description: This year's summit comes amid the US-Israel war on Iran, Russia's war on Ukraine and global economic challenges.

item.title: ‘The family paid the price’: India’s deadly online gambling crisis
item.description: Debts and deaths are mounting, as a soaring online gambling industry adapts to evade an Indian government ban.

item.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles off eastern coast, Seoul says
item.description: South Korea said it was closely exchanging information on the launches with the US and Japan.

item.title: Putin and Pezeshkian call out US dominance ahead of BRICS
item.description: The presidents of Iran and Russia have criticised US dollar dominance ahead of the BRICS summit in India.

item.title: CIA releases dozens of declassified documents on bin Laden prior to 9/11
item.description: A briefer told Clinton in 1998 that bin Laden’s 'preferred option is to strike the US on its own soil in Washington'.

item.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
item.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

item.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthis are also reported to have seized Perim - a strategic island on the major shipping route.

item.title: Grammy-winning US rapper Lil Durk acquitted in murder-for-hire trial
item.description: The Chicago rapper was arrested in 2024 and accused of involvement in a shooting that killed the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo.
